name: Ad Placements End-to-End (banner, purchase)
greenMarker: Ad placements verified by clicking them

mutations.name: an ad area is drawn while no advertiser is being served
mutations.why: A shipped build with VITE_ADS_PROVIDER=fake would show a grey box reading "테스트 | 광고 자리 (실제 광고 없음)" to every player and every reviewer. That reads as an unfinished app, which is a worse risk than any wording inside it.
mutations.expectFailure: an ad slot rendered with provider

mutations.name: the banner stops honouring Remove Ads
mutations.why: External audit V11. Case 4 used to run where the slot never appears, so this passed: nothing shown before, nothing shown after. With the stand-in plugin the slot really appears, and a player who paid would keep seeing it.
mutations.expectFailure: still shown to a player who has Remove Ads

mutations.name: an error thrown from a timer on the game screen
mutations.why: External audit V11. The story at the top of this gate is a TypeError thrown inside a setTimeout — invisible to React, visible only as a page error. The gate collected page errors and never read them, so that exact failure passed.
mutations.replace:
const removed = adsService.isAdsRemoved();
  useEffect(() => { const id = setTimeout(() => { throw new TypeError('onAdsRemovedPurchased is not a function'); }, 0); return () => clearTimeout(id); }, []);

note: The banner renders nothing while the placeholder provider is live, so this gate now checks the absence of an ad area rather than its wording. The mutation is the opposite of what it used to be: bringing the slot back is the defect.
